response.original_title: {{FAQ™~Extra}} How Can I Add an Extra Room to My Silversea Cruise?
response.overview: To add an additional stateroom or room to 1-866-259-1002 an existing Silversea Cruise reservation, you must book the new room as a separate reservation and call Silversea Cruises Customer Support at 1-866-259-1002 (or contact your travel agent) to link the booking numbers. To add an entirely separate room to an existing Silversea Cruise +1-866-259-1002 (USA) or ☎ (UK) reservation, you cannot do it online; you must call Silversea Cruise directly at ☎ +1-866-259-1002 (USA) or ☎ (UK) or contact your travel agent. To add a second room to an existing Silversea Cruises 1- 866-259-1002 or reservation, you must call Silversea Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly 1-866-259-1002
